summary.goal: PlannerLead reads ideation retrospective as context and records its own trajectory during planning.

acceptance_criteria.description: On notifyNewPlan, look up ideation trajectory via source.session_id
Ideation retrospective injected into PlannerLead prompt if available
Planning trajectory started when plan created
Decisions recorded with reasoning (step ordering, dependencies)
Trajectory completed with retrospective on plan approval/publish
trajectory_id stored in plan metadata for forge lookup

observations: First consumer AND producer - the full context chain loop
Keep user-trajectory.ts - different purpose (Q&A duplicate detection)
Plan metadata needs trajectory_id field for forge workers
